Action Plan:
1. Viral upper respiratory tract infection/early influenza suspected: advise 1–2 days off work, maintain adequate hydration, continue symptomatic relief with Paracetamol (dose/route/frequency not documented) and Ibuprofen (dose/route/frequency not documented). Monitor for red-flag symptoms (high fever, worsening shortness of breath, chest pain); return sooner if these occur or if no improvement within 1 week.
2. Provide written and verbal sick-note guidance for employer as needed.
3. Schedule follow-up appointment or telephone review in 7 days if symptoms persist.
4. Verbal consent from patient has been obtained before using transcription software.

Subjective:
• 4-day history: initial sore throat and runny nose → improving sore throat, persistent nasal congestion, new dry cough (onset yesterday).  
• Associated symptoms: night sweats, headaches (intermittent, generalized), myalgia, fatigue, mild exertional dyspnea, reduced appetite, increased fluid intake.  
• No chest pain at rest, no ear pain/discharge, no visual disturbance, no photophobia, no nausea/vomiting, bowels and urination normal, no skin rash.  
• Fever present days 1–2; responds to Paracetamol/Ibuprofen; currently afebrile by report.  

Past Medical History: none reported.  
Surgical History: not discussed.  
Medications: Paracetamol (dose/route/frequency not documented), Ibuprofen (dose/route/frequency not documented).  
Allergies: no known drug allergies.  
Family History: grandmother – type 2 diabetes; great-grandfather – eczema.  
Social History: lives alone; accountant; occasional cigars at social events; occasional alcohol; no regular smoking.

Objective:
• No physical examination or vital signs performed (telehealth consult).  
• No investigations available.

Assessment & Plan:

1. Viral upper respiratory tract infection / early influenza‐like illness  
   - Assessment: Likely viral URTI; symptoms consistent with early flu.  
   - Differential diagnosis: Influenza, COVID-19 (not specifically addressed), bacterial pharyngitis (less likely given improvement, lack of exudate).  
   - Investigations: None at this stage; consider COVID-19 test if symptoms worsen or workplace policy requires.  
   - Treatment: Rest; increase oral fluids; continue Paracetamol and Ibuprofen as needed; take 1–2 days off work.  
   - Referrals: None currently.

● Missing elements: No vital signs recorded; no COVID-19 screening questions documented; medication doses not specified.  
● Internal conflicts: None noted.  
● Transcript quality: Clear audio with minor filler words; clinical content adequate.
